Textbook-wide math typography audit

Read-only candidates, not confirmed errors. No source edits or deployment. Current-renderer previews appear below; the live-page link may still show an earlier publication. Some relocated summary/exercise anchors link onward.

Coverage: arithmetic, relations/sets, arrows, fences/bars, sums/products/integrals, logic, calculus and other Unicode mathematical symbols, plus named functions. Symbols such as ∂, ∞, bars and unit slashes need semantic review; valid unary signs and intentional layout must be preserved. This structural audit cannot prove every spacing defect or mathematical meaning.
